question: Which of the following is NOT** a method of irrigation?**
solution:
The correct answer is __**Check dams**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Check dams** are primarily constructed to conserve water by slowing down the flow of small streams or rivers. They help in water harvesting and groundwater recharge but are not classified as a formal method of irrigation. Hence, *check dams are not a method of irrigation*.
 
• **River lift systems** are a recognized irrigation method. They involve lifting water from rivers using pumps or other mechanisms to supply water to agricultural fields. *This statement is correct.*
 
• **Canals** are an integral part of irrigation systems. They are constructed to divert water from rivers or reservoirs to agricultural lands. *This statement is correct.*
 
• **Wells** are one of the oldest and most common irrigation methods. Farmers draw water from underground sources using wells for irrigation purposes. *This statement is correct.*
